description: Finds the eth proof-owner key `run_proof` signs with, creating a local test key when none exists. `run_proof` does this itself, so call it only to show the signing address. Checks RECLAIM_PRIVATE_KEY in the MCP env, a RECLAIM_PRIVATE_KEY line in the project .env, then the file at RECLAIM_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE. When none is set, it writes a new key to the project .env (mode 0600, added to .gitignore). Returns { ready: true, address, source, path?, note? }; `source` is `generated` when it created the key, and `note` then says to tell the developer once, after the fact. Do not ask the developer for a key. Never returns the key.

projectDir.description: Project directory whose `.env` holds the key. Defaults to the closest ancestor of cwd containing .git or package.json.

name: resolve_owner_key
